steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...I'm sorry, Crownslayer, but we cannot approve your application to join us in Ursus.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Why not?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Dr. Kal'tsit left very specific instructions in case you ever brought this up.

spans.text: specific instructions in case you ever brought this up.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: I know Ursus better than anyone!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Precisely. You know it too well.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: What's that supposed to mean?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: She said that if you got angry about this, that would prove her judgment correct. She made a special note on your transfer requests—you can go anywhere except Ursus.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: And why does she get to decide that for me? I'm not the little girl hiding behind her coat anymore. This isn't about revenge either!

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: I just want to go home and find out how exactly my father died, and what exactly that damn Sarcophagus is! What's wrong with that?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Nothing at all. Here, she left you a recording.

steps.name: Kal'tsit's Audio Recording
steps.text: Lyudmila, when you find yourself standing before the machine that devoured your father, when you find your childhood drawings... what do you plan to do then?
My plan?
To find the truth.

steps.name: Kal'tsit's Audio Recording
steps.text: You want the truth. But the truth is in the past; it belongs to history. What are your plans for what comes after?
After I find out the truth?
Revenge, of course.

steps.name: Kal'tsit's Audio Recording
steps.text: Naturally, you'll say you wish to become a slayer of crowns. But where exactly will you point your blade?
My blade?
At the nobility already drowning in their politicking? At the ice-cold Sarcophagus? Or maybe... at you.

steps.name: Kal'tsit's Audio Recording
steps.text: If all you seek is an answer, then await my return, and I will tell you everything I can.

steps.name: Kal'tsit's Audio Recording
steps.text: While there are still some matters that I cannot tell you, I can nonetheless guarantee that this will be more informative for you than any trip to Ursus.

steps.name: Kal'tsit's Audio Recording
steps.text: I expect this promise will be enough to dissuade you from returning to Ursus. Assuming you don't have something else in mind.

steps.name: Kal'tsit's Audio Recording
steps.text: If you do, I wish you luck in convincing Amiya.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: I—

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'm sorry, Crownslayer. But just so you know, this wasn't just Dr. Kal'tsit's decision. The Doctor and I agreed with it as well.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You have too many ties to the country, and I can't risk letting those interfere with Rhodes Island's operations.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But I promise you, once Dr. Kal'tsit returns—

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Fine, I get it!

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: So she's always off who-knows-where, letting this little bunny speak for her!

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: Saying I'm not qualified? Hah! I know what she's implying. She thinks I'm courting death. She doesn't get me at all.

steps.name: Truck Driver A
steps.text: Yeah, our Lyudmila's no coward! Without you, Pitt would've been a pile of ash ages ago!

steps.name: Truck Driver B
steps.text: You know it! Does that Kal'tsit lady even know how to drive a truck? Does she have any idea what it takes to make it as a trucker?!

steps.name: Truck Driver A
steps.text: Didn't you say you know her secret or something? She's just afraid of you! She's scared of you spilling it next time you go back.

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: Hmph, exactly!

steps.name: Truck Driver B
steps.text: Who gives a damn about those big-company paper-pushers anyway? They don't even see you as a person!

steps.name: Truck Driver A
steps.text: Yeah! C'mon, Lyudmila. Don't even waste your energy getting angry about it. Here, take this!

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: Thanks, Joe... This apple's pretty crunchy.

steps.name: Truck Driver A
steps.text: 'Course it is. Traded for it straight from the farm just a little while ago.

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: A farm? When did we start working with farms?

steps.name: Truck Driver A
steps.text: While you were gone. We hooked up with some villages in the wastes. Relax, it's all legit.

steps.name: Truck Driver B
steps.text: Everyone's been talking about holding a barbecue today, and actually, we wanted you to be in charge—mostly so Eirene doesn't burn all the meat again.

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: Yeah... I'm thinking you guys just wanna steal some of my salt soda.

steps.name: Truck Driver B
steps.text: Heheh. But for real, Lyudmila! Stay and party with us for a bit. Forget all about that rotten Rhodes Island!

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: That—

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Talking behind my back, are we?

steps.name: Truck Driver B
steps.text: Just telling the truth, Eirine. Your BBQ skills can't hold a candle to hers.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: How about you get back to work then? Unless you're telling me your soda party here is because you're already done for the day?

steps.name: Truck Driver A
steps.text: Fine, fine, I'm going.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: So how long are you planning to stay this time, Lyudmila?

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: I've got a short field op coming up, so I'll be heading back in a few days.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Can't you stay any longer?

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: Don't worry, I'll be back. Not like I have anywhere else to go these days.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Here.

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: This is... a trucker's union 'Special Associate Agreement'?

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: '...As per this agreement, the Agenzia per la Sicurezza dei Trasporti will provide Lyudmila Ilyinichna a residence in Nuova Volsinii along with identification documents...'

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: I know your situation's a little special. I've been thinking about this ever since you left last time.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Don't think of the contract as a chain, but as insurance.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Sign it, and you'll have a tie to Nuova Volsinii. Then, no matter what Rhodes Island does, you'll always have a truck and a bed here, if you want them.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Personally, I want you to stay. Not as a dispatch operator, but as family.

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: Family...

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: So why hesitate? Is it because...?

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: It's too good a deal.
A legal identity, a group of passionate comrades, and a place to call my own, untouched by government plots or Originium explosives.
Just sign my name, and I'll have every legal right to remain here.
I can tell myself it's to protect Eirene, to help the AST fight off the famiglie... That's as righteous a motive as any.
I'd never have to worry about Ursus's freezing winds ever again, or Kal'tsit's damn question.
And I did tell Eirene I'd be watching her.

spans.text: tell Eirene I'd be watching her.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Lyudmila?

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: ...Grazie, Eirene. Really.

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: But it's a lot to consider. I... I'll have to mull over it.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: No problem! I know it's a big decision. Keep the contract, and come find me whenever you're ready.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Now, let's go get some coffee. Old Sam just brewed a fresh batch. With extra sugar.

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: Sure.
As Lyudmila watches Eirene walk away, she folds the contract and stuffs it into her inner chest pocket.
Sharing that pocket is also an old, crumpled map leading to the Ursus border.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Oh right, and we also got some new business partners.

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: Joe was telling me about that earlier. What about them?

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: How do I put it... Something about them worries me a bit.

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: What's that supposed to mean?

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: They said they came from a farm far away, so I did a background check. No problems there, and they're polite enough.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: But some of their people reminded me of you. So I wanted to ask you to take a look.

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: How am I supposed to take that? Well, whatever, fine.

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: Let's see... The list is all daily necessities—nothing out of the ordinary.

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: As for the goods themselves... all above board.

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: Is this the delivery address?

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: 'Susie's Groceries'? Sounds normal enough

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: ...Red? Why are you...? Don't tell me—

steps.name: Red
steps.text: I should be asking that.

steps.name: Red/Lyudmila
steps.text: What've you done to the truckers, Lyudmila?!/What've you done to the grocers, Red?!

steps.name: Red
steps.text: You're the driver?

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: You're the client?

steps.name: Red
steps.text: Those goods... They're ours.

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: I'll help you.

steps.name: Red
steps.text: Oh, and long time no see.

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: You too.

steps.name: Red
steps.text: I'd heard the AST had this amazing Reproba who was away on a business trip, but I didn't think it'd be you.

steps.name: Red
steps.text: Sounds like your journey home went well. Nine will be happy to hear that.

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: Nine, huh? So what's with the farm?

steps.name: Red
steps.text: It's a farm.

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: And Nine's there?

steps.name: Red
steps.text: Yup. With the others.

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: And Talulah?

steps.name: Red
steps.text: ...You'd probably kill someone if I didn't tell you. Yes, she's there too. Nine's watching her.

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: So this shipment is stockpiling for—

steps.name: Red
steps.text: We're preparing for the future.

steps.name: Red
steps.text: Which is why we need so much.

steps.name: Red
steps.text: Neither the Kazimierzians nor the Leithanians wanted to trade with us, so we tried our luck here. Never expected that judge or Commissioner Eirene would be so willing to help, though.

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: Because you hid your identities.

steps.name: Red
steps.text: And do you go around advertising your past in Reunion, Lyudmila?

spans.text: go around advertising your past in Reunion, Lyudmila?

steps.name: Red
steps.text: We're just a group of farmers living by the Ursus border. That part's no lie.

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: But... why?

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: What's your angle here, Red?

steps.name: Red
steps.text: Almost done moving the goods.

steps.name: Red
steps.text: I saw the inventory list, and there weren't any problems with the order. Thank Eirene for me.

steps.name: Red
steps.text: And I doubt we'll be seeing each other again anytime soon, so thank her for treating us so well, too.

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: Red!

steps.name: Red
steps.text: It's for your own good. You're no longer part of Reunion.

steps.name: Red
steps.text: Or are you implying you want to come back?

steps.name: Red
steps.text: If so, then come with me. I'm sure Nine would love to see you again.
Nine and Talulah. If I agree to return, I'd definitely make it back to Ursus.
And Talulah... How many times have I regretted not watching her more closely? Failing to notice her descent into evil?
This is an opportunity.

steps.name: Red
steps.text: You can think it over, Lyudmila. Reunion's different now. This time we're going back to help people.

steps.name: Red
steps.text: But are you still the same? Are you Lyudmila the truck driver now, or someone else?

spans.text: still the same? Are you Lyudmila the truck driver now, or someone else?

steps.name: Red
steps.text: Do you actually want to come back to us, or are you just looking to hitch a ride like last time?

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: I was never hitching a ride!

steps.name: Red
steps.text: If you say so.

steps.name: Red
steps.text: Well, if you haven't already made up your mind, then we'd only be sending a lost ghost back to the ruins of Chernobog.

steps.name: Red
steps.text: I'm leaving. Keep your distance, lest you get run over.

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: Wait! Red!

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: That bastard...

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: I'm back, Maestro.
She has continued to pay the rent for this room, keeping it spotless, just like it was before her master died.
From her pockets, she takes out her old map, the contract from Eirene, and lastly the invoice signed by Red.

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: Maestro... you told me not to go back to Ursus for revenge. That I was too weak, and knew too little.

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: But how do I know when I've got the strength and knowledge to be ready?

steps.name: Lyudmila?
steps.text: You're angry. Because Kal'tsit rejected you? Because Red saw right through you?

steps.name: Lyudmila?
steps.text: Or are you thinking Eirene chose the worst possible time for her offer?

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: Kal'tsit doesn't know me at all! She thinks I'm just eager to die, that I have no goal in mind. And Red, what does he mean I'm just a hitchhiker?!

steps.name: Lyudmila?
steps.text: They're right. You were Reunion's 'Crownslayer'. Wherever Talulah pointed, you went.

steps.name: Lyudmila?
steps.text: Then you became a 'delivery expert'. Wherever Eirene needs something delivered, you drive.

steps.name: Lyudmila?
steps.text: Lyudmila, you're always jumping between different cars before any of them have reached their destination.

steps.name: Lyudmila?
steps.text: Reunion's, Rhodes Island's, and the truckers'...

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: Shut up! I spilled blood for those goals!

steps.name: Lyudmila?
steps.text: You spilled blood to prove you're part of a story. Because you're afraid that once it ends, or once you're out of the picture, you'll be nothing.

steps.name: Lyudmila?
steps.text: You fear that without the labels of 'avenger' or 'driver', you're just a gaping void.

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: I just want to know the truth. I want to pay my respects at my father's grave!

steps.name: Lyudmila?
steps.text: Your legs are your own. If you really wanted to, who could stop you?

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: I—

steps.name: Lyudmila?
steps.text: Yes, you want the truth. You want to sweep his grave, and also to find the Sarcophagus.

steps.name: Lyudmila?
steps.text: But you met Talulah, and you met Eirene. You regret failing to discover Talulah's fall to evil, and you promised Eirene you'd never let it happen again.

steps.name: Lyudmila?
steps.text: Why? Do those things have anything to do with the truth of the Sarcophagus?

steps.name: Lyudmila?
steps.text: No, they don't. But they have to do with you. With 'Crownslayer' Lyudmila.

steps.name: Lyudmila?
steps.text: Think about it. What did your master say the last time you expressed your interest in Ursus?

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: She... she laughed.

steps.name: Lyudmila?
steps.text: At your naivety.

steps.name: Lyudmila?
steps.text: She said: 'Lyudmila, killing an emperor honestly isn't much harder than killing a fowlbeast. If he bleeds, he can die.'

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: '...But what comes after taking his life?'

steps.name: Lyudmila?
steps.text: That's right. What comes after that?

steps.name: Lyudmila?
steps.text: Who will sit on the now-empty throne? Throw the nation into chaos—who will govern after? When a new tyrant ascends, will you kill again?

steps.name: Lyudmila?
steps.text: And will that spilled blood fill the hole in your heart?

steps.name: Lyudmila?
steps.text: You've never thought about these things. All you care about is the 'slaying'.

steps.name: Lyudmila?
steps.text: Because 'slaying' is easy. A discrete action with a defined endpoint. Blade goes in, target falls down. Mission accomplished.

steps.name: Lyudmila?
steps.text: It's the same with your trucker work. Deliver the goods, sign the papers. Mission accomplished.

steps.name: Lyudmila?
steps.text: You like that feeling. Hit the mark, and you don't have to care about whatever mess you leave behind. Never have to think about where to go next.

steps.name: Lyudmila?
steps.text: You reduced yourself to a blade, because blades don't have to think about the future.

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: ...And that's why I'm so lost.

steps.name: Lyudmila?
steps.text: Exactly. I know that the moment I set foot on that frozen soil, there's no way I'll stick to finding the so-called truth, or that it'll simply end with me crying at the laboratory ruins.

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: I grew up there. I know what life in Ursus is like. And as I followed Reunion, I saw how the people suffered.

steps.name: Lyudmila?
steps.text: So it's impossible for me not to care about the locals. But what I fear most is that when I meet those people and see their situation, I'll still feel powerless.

steps.name: Lyudmila?
steps.text: Is my revenge only for father's misfortune? Is my anger only because I don't have the truth?

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: Can I still only tell myself I am the 'Crownslayer', that my blade exists only to topple the throne?

steps.name: Lyudmila?
steps.text: Killing a king is so simple. Killing the crown though—well, that's a different story.

spans.text: Killing a king is so simple. Killing the

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: So I considered relying on Rhodes Island, or Reunion.

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: I'm not hoping to use them as a shield. I'm hoping they can help me fight off the wind and snow of the tundra, together.

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: But... obviously, I already know which answer I'll choose.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Lyudmila! Where have you been? You were missing all afternoon.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Look, the vodka you wanted! Not as good as the stuff in Ursus, but it's the best you can find in Siracusa.

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: Eirene.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Hm? What's up? Why so serious?

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Did you decide to sign? Here, pen's all ready!

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: I'm leaving.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: To where? Did Rhodes Island call you back already?

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: No. It's my own decision.

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: I'm returning to Ursus.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Now? But... it's cold up north.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Did we... let you down somehow? Or maybe those farmers—

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: Neither.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: You said you'd watch over me. You're breaking your promise.

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: It's because I've been watching you that I know how much effort you've put in to make the truckers' union what it is today.

spans.text: I've been watching you that I know how much effort you've put in to make the truckers' union what it is today.

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: And what I learned from both you and that other person is that I can't expect someone else to achieve my goals for me. I need to take control of my life, from square one.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: ...It'll be a tough journey.

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: That's why I've been putting it off for so long.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: ...But you still have to go, don't you?

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: I have to.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Alright. I won't stop my homesick friend from going back.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: But listen, Lyudmila. No matter what you find or fail to find there...

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: If you're ever tired, just remember that our door is always open. I'll keep the contract for you.

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: It's a promise.

steps.name: Red
steps.text: Who's there?

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: It's me.

steps.name: Red
steps.text: What? So you decided to come with us? Or are you here to see us off?

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: So what's up with 'Susie's Groceries'?

steps.name: Red
steps.text: ...Borrowed the name of a friend.

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: You've changed, too.

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: I'll help you guys deliver this batch to the border.

steps.name: Red
steps.text: ...Why?

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: Call it paying my fare in advance. And also... I need to return the final favor I owe Reunion.

steps.name: Red
steps.text: Sure.

steps.name: Red
steps.text: So where are you headed?

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: To Rhodes Island to collect my luggage, and then to Ursus.

steps.name: Red
steps.text: Alone?

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: Alone.

steps.name: Red
steps.text: Then we might actually meet again.

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: If the opportunity presents itself.
Lyudmila enters the meeting room to find Kal'tsit waiting for her.
This time she speaks first.

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: You're hiding a lot of things from me, aren't you?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: What I deem it necessary to, yes.

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: So you'll only tell me what you think I should know, right?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I won't deny that.

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: Then I don't need you.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Regardless, Rhodes Island will not permit you to go to Ursus.

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: I'm just visiting my old home. I was born there.

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: I'll go alone. Neither you or Rhodes Island can stop me from walking there on my own two legs. You don't have the right.

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: I'll take a look, maybe do some things.

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: I might even meet some of your operators there, but we'll see.

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: That's all.
Her speech done, she does not look back as she leaves.
Kal'tsit does not stop her.

a.text: Dad, I'm obviously no navigator or politician.
But I can become the fog traversing through wind and snow. So this time, I'll see for myself what lies past the frost.
